records.title: Why the Smart Gravity DCA Model Triggered a 2.5x "Aggressive Crash Buy" Allocation
records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 1 July 2026.

[2026-07-01_DCA_MODEL]  
Video Title: Why the Smart Gravity DCA Model Triggered a 2.5x "Aggressive Crash Buy" Allocation  
Video ID: hO6otRVZsQg  
Smart Gravity DCA Model (DCA_MODEL) | Class: EQUITY  

Current Market Structure  
The model segments the market into four regimes based on a rolling z‑score: 100% crash (z > 1), deep crash (z ≈ ‑1.2), neutral (‑0.5  1). In the 2025‑2026 window Bitcoin’s 20‑week SMA crossed below the 50‑week SMA, signaling a shift from accumulation to breakout, while the 200‑week SMA remained below the price, confirming a bearish trend. Momentum is strongest in the neutral regime, where the model deploys 1.5× the weekly paycheck, whereas in the crash regime it deploys 2.5×, exploiting the 4‑year cycle’s dip. Accumulation peaks during the deep crash, with cash reserves building up to $5,000 before aggressive deployment.  

Quantitative Valuation & Gravity  
The TWAP baseline for a $50 weekly DCA over the past four years yields an ROI of 20% for a blind strategy, whereas the smart gravity approach achieves 41% by holding cash during overheated periods and deploying 2.5× during crashes. A 4‑year CAGR gravity model shows a 64% return for the smart model versus 10% for a static DCA, with a 2.5× multiplier applied at z ≈ ‑1.2 and a 4.5× cap during extreme capitulation. The Efficient Frontier places the smart model in the upper right quadrant (high return, moderate volatility), outperforming the blind DCA’s lower left position.  

Target Floors & Trap Identifications  
ML forecasts target a floor when z drops below ‑0.5, triggering a 2.5× crash buy; panic floors are set at ‑1.2, where the model switches from cash to aggressive allocation. Standard deviation bands of ±1.5σ around the 20‑week SMA delineate value traps, while euphoria overextensions are flagged when z exceeds +1, prompting a 100% cash hold. Explicitly named traps include the “Bitcoin 2025 correction” (neutral zone at $50 paycheck, 1.6× accumulation) and the “2026 bull run” (projected to conclude in 2029).  

---
